name: desk-tools-local-proxy
description: Local WebSocket bridge between the Desk-tools web app and SSH, Telnet, MySQL, PostgreSQL, Hive and Trino. Runs entirely on your machine; nothing is sent to any third party.

scripts.build:bun: bun build ./index.js --compile --target=bun-darwin-arm64 --outfile dist/local-proxy-macos-arm64 && bun build ./index.js --compile --target=bun-darwin-x64 --outfile dist/local-proxy-macos-x64 && bun build ./index.js --compile --target=bun-linux-x64 --outfile dist/local-proxy-linux-x64 && bun build ./index.js --compile --target=bun-windows-x64 --outfile dist/local-proxy-windows-x64.exe
